scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:rust
scripts.prestart:node: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:node
scripts.pretest: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:node && cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --locked && TEST_BACKEND=rust node --test build/test/*.test.js
scripts.pretest:node: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:node
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
